description: The RenderService.java file provides rendering and layout services for Android layouts within the Android Studio environment. It acts as a wrapper around the layout library, managing rendering sessions, resource resolution, device configurations, and rendering options.

classes.name: RenderService
classes.description: Provides rendering and layout information for Android layouts, managing rendering sessions, resource resolution, device configurations, and rendering options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a RenderService instance associated with a given AndroidFacet, Module, PsiFile, Configuration, logger, and optional RenderContext.

methods.name: canRender
methods.description: Checks if a given PsiFile can be rendered by the service.

methods.name: renderDrawable
methods.description: Renders a drawable resource value into an image.

methods.name: getLayoutLib
methods.description: Returns the LayoutLibrary instance used by this RenderService.

methods.name: getLayoutlibCallback
methods.description: Returns the LayoutlibCallback associated with this RenderService.

methods.name: supportsCapability
methods.description: Checks if the layout library supports a specific capability.

methods.name: getLayoutLibrary
methods.description: Retrieves the LayoutLibrary for a given module and target.

methods.name: isNonRectangular
methods.description: Indicates if the service can render non-rectangular shapes (e.g., drawable images).

methods.name: requiresTransparency
methods.description: Indicates if rendering into a transparent/alpha channel image is required.

methods.name: useDesignMode
methods.description: Configures the RenderService for design mode, affecting layout measurement and rendering behavior.

methods.name: measure
methods.description: Measures the children of a given parent element and returns view info.

methods.name: measureChildren
methods.description: Measures the children of a parent XmlTag applying a specified attribute filter.

methods.name: measureChild
methods.description: Measures a specific child XmlTag with a given attribute filter.
